_comment: Recover missing red-team results on already-reviewed heads via the existing review job. Env: WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM_ON_SKIP (0/1), WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM_ON_SKIP_RETRY_COOLDOWN_MIN, WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM_ON_SKIP_STALE_REDISPATCH_DAILY_CAP, WE_REVIEW_RED_TEAM_ON_SKIP_CI_HELD_RECORD_RETRY_MAX (integer 0..10, default 3; 0 disables CI-held record retries).
